description:
The predictive (PRD) step of a PFD assessment.

Variant-type-agnostic shape: an in-silico prediction, its SM 18 transcript-
relevance / mechanism adjustment, and the resulting coded ``_PRD`` value.
Typed predictor/path enums arrive with the per-variant-type workflows.

adjusted_points.description: Coded _PRD points after the SM 18 adjustment.
adjusted_points.title: Adjusted Points

initial_points.description: Initial evidence points before the SM 18 adjustment.
initial_points.title: Initial Points

mechanism_applied.description: Whether the SM 18 mechanism step applied (not for the missense amino-acid path, where predictors capture both LoF and GoF).
mechanism_applied.title: Mechanism Applied

path_label.description: Flow-diagram path/color (e.g. GREEN, YELLOW); typed later.
path_label.title: Path Label

predictor.description: In-silico predictor or basis used (e.g. REVEL, NMD prediction).
predictor.title: Predictor

raw_score.description: The predictor's raw score, if applicable.
raw_score.title: Raw Score

transcript_relevance_applied.description: Whether the SM 18 transcript-relevance step reduced the points.
transcript_relevance_applied.title: Transcript Relevance Applied

title: PfdPredictiveEvidence
